holdout_card.fact_statement: 2025 GN1 does not show evidence of dust ejection despite its extreme thermal environment.
holdout_card.source_span: Despite its extreme thermal environment, 2025 GN1 does not show evidence of dust ejection nor blue tinting of its surface by heated refractory organics.

qa_variants.question: What phenomenon does 2025 GN1 show no evidence of, despite its extreme thermal environment?
qa_variants.source_span: Despite its extreme thermal environment, 2025 GN1 does not show evidence of dust ejection nor blue tinting of its surface by heated refractory organics.
